gaps.sentence: I could hear the neighbours ___ again last night.
gaps.explanation: hear + object + -ing = hear an action in progress: hear them arguing.
deny + -ing or having + past participle: denied doing/having done. Both accepted.

gaps.sentence: The children are looking forward to ___ Father Christmas.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO + -ing: looking forward to meeting.
happen + to-infinitive = do something by chance: happen to know.

gaps.sentence: Don't forget ___ the plants while we're away.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do something you should do.

gaps.sentence: They're planning ___ the flat before selling it.
gaps.explanation: plan + to-infinitive (plan on + -ing also occurs informally): planning to redecorate.

gaps.sentence: I can't afford ___ another month abroad.
He went on ___ even after the audience had left.
gaps.explanation: go on + -ing = continue the same activity; go on to do = do something next.
